title: Paul Smith remote views the USS Stark attack

tellings.quote: I started describing this vessel, which reminded me of an American destroyer.

plain: In 1987, during the war between Iran and Iraq, a man named Paul Smith says he was given a target in a US government psychic spy program and began, in his words, "describing this vessel, which reminded me of an American destroyer." He ties this to the attack on the USS Stark, an American Navy warship hit in the Persian Gulf that year. Smith tells it as his own session in remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe a distant place or event with the mind alone. He names a colleague, Skip Atwater, and points to the Washington Post for the record, and if it is true, a psychic picked up a real attack from far away.
